function.name: verify_customer
function.description: Authenticates the customer using the last 4 digits of PAN, Aadhaar, or Date of Birth prior to debt disclosure.

verification_code.description: The 4-digit verification code or PIN provided by the customer

function.name: log_promise_to_pay
function.description: Records a binding Promise-to-Pay (PTP) date and committed amount in the collection database.

ptp_date.description: Agreed payment commitment date in YYYY-MM-DD format

payment_channel.description: Preferred payment mode (e.g., UPI_LINK, NETBANKING, CARD)

function.name: send_payment_link
function.description: Triggers an instant payment link dispatch via SMS and WhatsApp to the customer's mobile number.

phone_number.description: Customer mobile phone number with country code

function.name: escalate_to_agent
function.description: Transfers the call to a human collection supervisor or grievance officer.

reason.description: Reason for escalation (e.g., DEBT_DISPUTE, HARDSHIP_SETTLEMENT, AGENT_REQUEST)

call_summary.description: Brief summary of conversation context for the human agent

function.name: mark_disposition
function.description: Logs the final call disposition status and agent notes in the CRM.

notes.description: Detailed notes on call outcome and customer commitment
